figurative_meaning_en: to be under a spell or hypnotized
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথায় শুনতে শুনতে সবাই ঔষধ ধরা হয়ে গেল।
সে তার সৌন্দর্যে ঔষধ ধরা হয়ে পড়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: Everyone was hypnotized while listening to his words.
He has fallen under her spell due to her beauty.
note: This idiom draws from the idea of medicine overpowering the body, extended metaphorically to mental or emotional influence in Bengali folklore.
